purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public cadastral viewer review, bounded anonymous access, safe-field handling, and uncertainty.
assessment: ICES is a real first-party cadastral custodian for Sinaloa and publishes a Mazatlán manzanero viewer route. The route embeds an ices-oblix backend, but the backend returned Cloudflare 522 during this attempt. The separate cadastral-information portal exposes a ClaveCatastral lookup and payment workflow, not an anonymous parcel geometry endpoint. No geometry sample is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official state cadastral institution, its Mazatlán-specific viewer route, and its cadastral-information service. This is local/state cadastral evidence, not proof of current complete parcel coverage or source integration readiness.
